03936 La`dan {lah-dawn'}

與 03935 同源; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Laadan 7; 7

拉但 = "整理就序"

1) 以法蓮人，約書亞的先祖 (#代上 7:26|)
2) 革順的後裔
record.edic_text:
03936 La`dan {lah-dawn'}

from the same as 03935;; n pr m

AV - Laadan 7; 7

Laadan = "put in order"
1) an Ephraimite ancestor of Joshua, son of Nun
2) a Levite son of Gershom; also 'Libni'
